children: Fertilizer stocks CF Industries and Nutrien fell on Monday after President Donald Trump said he was working on a deal with Belarus to purchase a key fertilizer component at lower prices.
CF Industries stock declined 1.5% to $125.80 on Monday while Nutrien dropped 2.3% to $75.30. Shares of Mosaic fell 0.4% to $24.40. Intrepid Potash declined 2% to $36.80.

The decline among fertilizer stocks followed Trump's proclamation on social-media platform Truth Social that the U.S. is currently negotiating a deal to purchase potash, a key fertilizer ingredient, from Belarus.
"The pricing would be for substantially less than we are currently paying to Canada, very good news for our Farmers and Ranchers," Trump wrote.

The president seems to be working on the deal to reduce U.S. reliance on Canadian-produced potash as the U.S.-Canada trade war continues. Canada supplies about 80% of potash used on U.S. farms, according to Nutrien.
Potash prices have increased sharply since Russia invaded Ukraine in 2022.
The White House didn't respond to a request for comment from Barron's.

With few details available, it's difficult to know how much potash this could bring to the U.S. or how much Belarus even has available. Investors in fertilizer stocks, however, were still responding negatively at the prospect of more potash hitting the U.S. market.

Without nitrogen, phosphate, and potash, yields on corn, wheat, and soybeans collapse, and food becomes far more expensive to produce. This all makes fertilizer and the potash ingredient key to the U.S. economy.
Shares of fertilizers producers have received a boost from the conflict between the U.S. and Iran, with the Strait of Hormuz handling roughly one-third of the fertilizer trade.

CF Industries stock has risen 61% this year but remained about 11% below its record closing high of $139.27 from Sept. 2. Nutrien stock has risen 21%. Shares of Mosaic, meanwhile, have declined about 1% this year.

CF Industries mainly produces nitrogen fertilizers like urea and ammonia. Nutrien is more diversified but is a major potash producer and also has a large retail distribution business-that means it's exposed to nitrogen fertilizers, but not as much as CF. Mosaic is even more exposed to phosphate and potash.
